Under Platform_Config_Registry_LOCKED.md:31 a run with no config snapshot id and hash is CONFIG_UNBOUND: not admissible as evidence of reproducibility, "because the configuration that produced it cannot be recovered". A run in that state cannot be cited as evidence that a workflow ran under any particular configuration, live or historical, and so not as evidence of an implicit override.
